scope: Recent primary journal sources 2025–2026 plus official QAT implementation; no transfer of clinical performance claims

references.title: MicroNAS for memory and latency constrained hardware aware neural architecture search in time series classification on microcontrollers
references.evidence: Primary publisher record and author-institution PDF/abstract inspected; local PDF retry returned HTTP 503
references.use: Motivates resource-constrained time-series model design and quantization-aware evaluation; no NAS search performed here

references.title: From PPG to Blood Pressure at the Edge: Quantization-Aware Architecture Selection and On-MCU Validation
references.evidence: Primary full-text methods and limitations inspected
references.use: Use quantization stability in architecture evaluation; paper acknowledges random window splitting and no subject disjointness, which is not adopted

references.title: Cross-Layer Resource Optimization for Ultra-Low-Power TinyML Inference on ARM Cortex-M Microcontrollers
references.use: Joint model/memory/hardware constraints; paper z-score normalization is not a mathematical hard bound. Our bounded transform is a new tested adaptation, not literal reproduction. Mixed precision/DVFS are not implemented

references.title: Quantization aware training comprehensive guide
references.evidence: Official implementation reference, not a journal article
references.use: Fine-tune with QAT; custom QuantizeConfig is experimental and requires actual integer operator/parity/target checks

references.title: LiteMamba-EMG: A Lightweight Mamba-based Framework for Robust sEMG-based Swallowing Activity Classification in Dysphagia Patients
references.evidence: Publisher metadata and abstract inspected after R3 training; full methods/target hardware not verified
references.use: Future hypothesis: self-supervised pretraining and channel interaction. Abstract reports 2.56M parameters, incompatible with a direct dense INT8 model below 100KB. No Mamba, pretraining, distillation or source performance reproduced

references.title: Detection of Swallowing Events by Decision Tree Learning of Polyvinylidene Fluoride Film Signals
references.evidence: Publisher abstract and PDF measurement/preprocessing sections inspected after R3 training; participant split not verified
references.use: Plan PVDF domain-transfer and continuous-event evaluation separately from D4 clip classification. No human procedure or published sensor performance reproduced
